completedActions.description: Implement AudioSynthesisSession for background audio synthesis

name: Implement SuttaCard long-press Background Playback prefetch

plannedActions.description: Design: Review SuttaCardView play button structure (toolbar at line 135-149) and AudioSynthesisSession state machine (SynthesisState enum at line 4-10, SessionSnapshot at line 13-23)

Implementation: Add @State var backgroundSession: AudioSynthesisSession? to SuttaCardView. Actor reference is Sendable and safe in @State. progressCallback fires on background thread; marshal UI updates via DispatchQueue.main.async (see AudioSynthesisSession.md SwiftUI Integration section for pattern)

Implementation: Add .onLongPressGesture to play button to initiate AudioSynthesisSession.execute(). .onLongPressGesture works directly on Button (coexists with tap action). Pattern documented in AudioSynthesisSession.md SwiftUI Integration section

Implementation: Create modal sheet view displaying SessionSnapshot progress (currentStep/totalSteps, estimatedCompletion, state). Handle SynthesisState.failed with error message display. Wire cancel button to session.cancel()

Implementation: Handle state transitions and session lifecycle. Add .onDisappear to modal sheet to detect dismissal and cancel active session. Add .onDisappear to SuttaCardView to cancel backgroundSession if mid-synthesis (prevent orphaned tasks)
Testing: Verify end-to-end prefetch: long-press initiates synthesis, modal shows progress updates (currentStep increments), completion updates state
Testing: Verify cancellation: close modal mid-synthesis, confirm session.cancel() invoked, pending segments discarded, app state remains consistent
Cleanup: Mark prepareSuttaAudio() in SuttaPlayer (line 137-204) as deprecated; document that AudioSynthesisSession is preferred for background synthesis

references.text: doc/BackgroundAudio.md — Architectural constraints: progress UI requirements (lines 112-115), synthesis timing (lines 99-108), cancellation/resume support (line 115)

doc/AudioSynthesisSession.md — API documentation and SwiftUI Integration pattern (lines 247-308) for holding actor in @State, calling async methods via Task/await, and thread marshaling in progressCallback

scv-core/Sources/AudioSynthesisSession.swift — actor-based background synthesis with state machine (SynthesisState: idle/synthesizing/completed/cancelled/failed), SessionSnapshot progress tracking, and cancellation support
scv-ui/Sources/scvUI/SuttaCardView.swift:135-149 — play button in toolbar; target for long-press gesture integration
scv-ui/Sources/scvUI/SuttaPlayer.swift:137-204 — deprecated prepareSuttaAudio() method; document migration to AudioSynthesisSession
scv-core/Sources/AudioContext.swift — AudioContext(for: language) initialization for synthesis audio context
scv-core/Sources/AudioStore.swift — AudioStore.shared.storeAudio() used by AudioSynthesisSession for persistence
